subject.title: perf: avoid event-loop stall during embedded_run bootstrap-context

question: Should OpenClaw accept the custom cooperative glob walker and bootstrap-only handler yielding as the bounded fix for this event-loop stall?
rationale: The patch addresses a reproduced P1 runtime problem without adding public API, but it changes compatibility-sensitive context resolution and session preparation behavior that automated review cannot authorize.

options.title: Accept after exact-head validation
options.body: Approve the internal scheduling and matching-engine tradeoff, then require a clean rebase and fresh focused plus changed-lane checks.

options.title: Require connected runtime proof
options.body: Ask for one current-head embedded run with active channel or WebSocket traffic showing responsiveness and unchanged injected context before merge.

options.title: Pause for a different runtime design
options.body: Hold or close the branch if maintainers prefer worker isolation, upstream Node changes, or another traversal owner instead of a custom matcher.

recommendation.title: Accept after exact-head validation
recommendation.body: Approve the internal scheduling and matching-engine tradeoff, then require a clean rebase and fresh focused plus changed-lane checks.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has the strongest current-main history across the guarded workspace reader, bootstrap hook path, and internal hook runtime.
